open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Dummit_Foote_exercise_2_4_16b {n : ℕ} {hn : n ≠ 0}
  {R : Subgroup (DihedralGroup n)}
  (hR : R = Subgroup.closure {DihedralGroup.r 1}) :
  R ≠ ⊤ ∧
  ∀ K : Subgroup (DihedralGroup n), R ≤ K → K = R ∨ K = ⊤ := by
  let H : Subgroup (DihedralGroup n) :=
    { carrier := Set.range DihedralGroup.r
      one_mem' := ⟨0, DihedralGroup.r_zero⟩
      mul_mem' := by
        rintro _ _ ⟨i, rfl⟩ ⟨j, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨i + j, rfl⟩
      inv_mem' := by
        rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨-i, rfl⟩ }
  have hRH : R ≤ H := by
    rw [hR, Subgroup.closure_le]
    rintro _ rfl
    exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
  have hHR : H ≤ R := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective i
    rw [← DihedralGroup.r_one_zpow, hR]
    exact Subgroup.zpow_mem _ (Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)) z
  have hRne : R ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    have hs : DihedralGroup.sr 0 ∈ H :=
      hRH (h ▸ Subgroup.mem_top _)
    rcases hs with ⟨i, hi⟩
    cases hi
  refine ⟨hRne, ?_⟩
  intro K hRK
  by_cases hs : ∃ i : ZMod n, DihedralGroup.sr i ∈ K
  · right
    apply top_unique
    intro x hx
    cases x with
    | r i =>
        exact hRK (hHR ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    | sr i =>
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hs
        have hrj : DihedralGroup.r j ∈ K :=
          hRK (hHR ⟨j, rfl⟩)
        have hs0 : DihedralGroup.sr 0 ∈ K := by
          simpa [DihedralGroup.inv_r] using
            K.mul_mem hj (K.inv_mem hrj)
        have hri : DihedralGroup.r i ∈ K :=
          hRK (hHR ⟨i, rfl⟩)
        simpa using K.mul_mem hs0 hri
  · left
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro x hx
      cases x with
      | r i =>
          exact hHR ⟨i, rfl⟩
      | sr i =>
          exact False.elim (hs ⟨i, hx⟩)
    · exact hRK
